TypeScript provides several utility types to facilitate common type transformations. These utilities are available globally.
This type is meant to model operations like in functions, or the method on s - specifically, the way that they recursively unwrap s.

ts type A = Awaited < Promise < string >>; type A = string type B = Awaited < Promise < Promise < number >>>; type B = number type C = Awaited < boolean | Promise < number >>; type C = number | boolean Try
